instruction.text: Replace the underlined part of the sentence with the correct personal pronoun.

atoms.a: <u>Julie and Ricardo</u> love playing video games together.
atoms.finishSound: They love playing video games together.

atoms.a: I will surprise <u>my mum</u> for Mother’s Day.
atoms.b: I will surprise ((her)) for Mother’s Day.
atoms.finishSound: I will surprise her for Mother’s Day.

atoms.a: Last summer, <u>James</u> visited his aunt in London.
atoms.b: Last summer, ((he)) visited his aunt in London.
atoms.finishSound: Last summer, he visited his aunt in London.

atoms.a: <u>Malik and I</u> will join the party later.
atoms.finishSound: We will join the party later.
